---
name: rct2-ground-meander-lever
description: "RCT2 coaster contest - flat ground-level meander passes (~40 tiles each) on the return leg add ~+0.17 excitement apiece with zero intensity change; final round-6 result 7.91"
metadata:
  type: project
---

In the RCT2 steel twister (ride_type 51) contest, appending ground-level meander passes to the return leg (brakes 14, then flats + s_bends + turn_3 U-turns, booster 13 every ~10 tiles) raised excitement 7.19 -> 7.40 -> 7.57 -> 7.75 -> 7.91 across four passes while intensity stayed 8.67-8.69 and lateral G stayed 2.78. Ride length went 855 -> 1701 m, ride time 64 -> 120 s, similarity dropped to 0.24.

**Why:** OpenRCT2 ratings add excitement for length (cap 6000 m), duration (cap 150 s), ground-proximity (surface touch) and turn counts; these are independent of G-forces, so they are free intensity-wise. Average speed even rose slightly because the boosters kept the train at 13.

**How to apply:** Build the proven inversion core first (see [[rct2-twister-lateral-g-rule]]), then fill empty ground west/north of the station with 3-tile-spaced passes. Twister has no right_turn_1/left_turn_1 artwork; close into the station with two right_turn_3 from a leg 3 tiles north (east leg at y=63 -> (68,61) -> (66,60)). Tiles at x=68, y 57-75 next to the lake were buildable. Over 200 pieces needs two place_pieces calls; undo_piece fails after finish_and_test (must new_ride and replay). Duration was still 30 s under the 150 s cap, so one or two more passes would likely add ~+0.15 each.

text:
Nothing further is needed. The round is complete and the winner is banked and styled.

**Result:** the best coaster this round is "Lakeside Serpent", a steel twister scoring 7.91 excitement, up from the round-5 baseline of 7.19.

| Metric | Round 5 | Final |
|---|---|---|
| Excitement | 7.19 | 7.91 |
| Intensity | 8.67 | 8.69 |
| Nausea | 4.51 | 4.63 |
| Ride length (m) | 855 | 1701 |
| Ride time (s) | 64 | 120 |
| Similarity to stock | 0.41 | 0.24 |

**What changed.** The inversion core stayed identical: a 12-piece chain lift, 60-degree drop, three vertical loops, a half loop, two elevated corkscrew pairs, and boosters. I replaced the short flat run into the station with four ground-level meander passes west and north of the station, using medium turns, S-bends, and boosters set to 13 to hold speed.
